The Organisational Structure was determined based on the main map section, while the division into categories was treated as part of the filtering mechanism. The final choice of Organisational Structure depends on which thematic modules are included in the analysis and on how the relationships between categories are interpreted

Despite the use of the Restricted Map Concept and the dominance of maps, the Visualization Atlas metaconcept was selected because maps serve as interfaces to data and additional graphics, cartographic representation is monotonous and visualization-oriented in style, and narrative texts and multimedia are absent

Despite the use of the Flexible Map Concept and maps serving as interfaces to data and additional graphics, the Cartographic Atlas Application metaconcept was selected because the atlas has well-developed traditional cartographic representation, with a wide variety of map methods and multivariate maps

The focus on quantitative data, limited variety of map methods, contour basemaps, and absence of narrative texts and multimedia support classifying the atlases on the Swiss Statatlas 2.0 platform (Swiss Stats Map Explorer) under the Visualization Atlas metaconcept, despite their lack of additional graphics and diagrams
The map style is traditional according to formal criteria; however, the variety of map methods is rather limited, and the main basemap is an contour map
